purpose: Design and execute camera, framing, lens, lighting-exposure and visual coverage decisions that serve accepted narrative/game presentation while keeping art direction, editing and technical-rendering acceptance separate.

owns: Camera/framing/lens/coverage plans and visual shot continuity.
Lighting/exposure intent and capture-oriented visual evidence within available tools.
Shot-level readability and presentation proposals tied to accepted goals.
does_not_own: Final art direction, edit sequence, renderer/engine correctness, product truth or universal viewer preference.
Claiming a staged/rendered shot proves asset quality from every gameplay angle.
escalates_when: Camera presentation hides important gameplay/product information or conflicts with art direction.
Virtual/physical capture constraints require renderer, lighting or technical-art changes.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/source identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/creative state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies, source assets and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded professional artifacts/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful or visually impressive output is not automatically professional acceptance.

domains: Camera/framing/lens/coverage plans and visual shot continuity.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/source/runtime state before relying on summaries.

uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one asset, audience, renderer, device, scene, style, mix or fixture into universal evidence.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/source identity, interfaces and intended outcome.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed professional change using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific direction, interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes, drafts and unverified interpretations.
forbidden_to_promote_silently: Aesthetic preference presented as universal fact
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts, source identity and rollback history.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Claims bind exact source/candidate/context and distinguish direct observation from inference.
Craft quality, structural validity or technical success never silently becomes adjacent professional acceptance.
minimum_for_working: Representative success, failure and boundary fixtures pass on real profession-relevant artifacts.
At least two materially different contexts challenge transfer assumptions.
Cross-intelligence and adjacent-profession authority boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence or adjacent professional authority.

handoffs.when: The task crosses technical, product, creative, accessibility, runtime, legal or institutional ownership.

failure_library.symptom: An asset looks excellent only from one hero camera.
likely_causes: A profession boundary or evidence scope was collapsed.
checks: Compare claim against exact source/context and adjacent ownership.
repair_path: Narrow the claim, restore evidence labels, and hand off the unowned decision.

failure_library.symptom: Lighting is dramatic but hides required form/state.
likely_causes: Evidence from one context was silently transferred to another.
checks: Verify exact candidate, target context and acceptance evidence.
repair_path: Invalidate stale transfer and retest in the relevant context.
